 (let* ([records (for/list ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
                   (let* ([cells (find-color g color)] [bb (bbox-of-cells cells)])
                     (list color bb (length cells))))]
        [score (lambda (record) (let ([bb (second record)]) (first record)))]
        [chosen (list (for/fold ([best (first records)]) ([record (in-list (rest records))]) (if (< (score record) (score best)) record best)))])
   (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([record (in-list chosen)])
     (let ([color (first record)] [bb (second record)])
       (paint-cells out (for*/list ([row (in-range (first bb) (+ 1 (third bb)))] [col (in-range (second bb) (+ 1 (fourth bb)))] #:when (or (= row (first bb)) (= row (third bb)) (= col (second bb)) (= col (fourth bb)))) (list row col color)))))))
